class TreeNode:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right

def supplyVaccine(root: TreeNode) -> int:
    def dfs(node):
        if not node:
            return [float('inf'), 0, 0]
        
        left = dfs(node.left)
        right = dfs(node.right)
        
        # Cost if we place a vaccine at this node
        cost_here = 1 + min(left) + min(right)
        
        # Cost if we do not place a vaccine at this node but cover it from children
        cost_not_here = left[1] + right[1]
        
        # Cost if we place a vaccine at one of the children
        cost_child_left = left[0] + min(right)
        cost_child_right = right[0] + min(left)
        
        return [cost_here, cost_not_here, cost_child_left, cost_child_right]
    
    return min(dfs(root))
